text:
jia: Heads-up: nightly e2e perf CI flagged a p95 latency regression on staging (run 1846123400). Gate failed: p95 +28% vs baseline. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/e2e-nightly-staging/7890 :eyes:

matt: I can grab logs and run a quick diff, on it now.

matt: looking at the job trace — spike starts after ~600s, tokens in the 64-128 range. Throughput dips and batching size shrinks.

jess: FYI PR #3421 changed the autoscheduler wait window from 8ms -> 15ms last week, might affect batch shapes.

alex: can we rerun the failing job with warmup enabled and with auto-batcher disabled to isolate? e.g. `./ci/run_e2e.sh --warmup=true --auto-batcher=false --job=e2e-nightly-staging`

rachel: kvcache metrics in that run look weird too, posted snippet from worker-3: ```KVCache hit_rate=0.12 mem=2.9GB evictions=4```

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @alex for job e2e-nightly-staging (build 7891). Queue position: 3. ETA ~12m.

matt: also seeing one worker with elevated GC pauses around the same window — might be memory pressure from larger KV entries.

jess: starting an automated bisect across commits (abc123..def456) that landed between the last green and this failure. Will run parallel small matrix. Link: https://ci.internal/bisect/555

deploy-bot: Non-critical deploys are paused while bisect jobs are running. :no_entry_sign:

alex: if bisect points at PR #3421 we should revert the autoscheduler change and re-run canary. I'll hold the rollback PR draft ready.

jia: thanks everyone. @matt please drop the bisect results here and tag infra if you need a deeper trace. If we confirm it's autoscheduler we should also add an e2e test variant with `--auto-batcher=false` to catch this earlier.

matt: noted — will report back when bisect finishes or earlier if I find a smoking gun. :thumbsup:
